verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an official MCP server, including a hosted variant, that MCP-capable AI clients such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code with Copilot and Windsurf can connect to. Through it, agents manage flags, AgentControl configs and observability data in natural language, and a probe confirms the docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working in practice, and detailed evidence of the exposed tool surface and authentication/scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: you enable the server, then use it to manage flags, AgentControl configs, and observability data with natural language.
you must have an AI client that supports MCP, such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code with Copilot, or Windsurf.
